      "rationale": "If field valves were open contrary to procedure (or an unrecorded routing change occurred), this would create a unique hazard scenario during boundary preparation, potentially leading to the observed pressure loss at P-R while upstream remained stable.",

      "counterfactual": "If field valves were closed per procedure and no unrecorded routing change occurred, the hazard scenario would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure loss could have originated from a source-side event (e.g., upstream valve closure or compressor trip) rather than an undocumented downstream condition.","evidenceGap": "No record establishes actual field valve positions or confirms whether any service-routing change was unrecorded at the time of the incident. The blank attachment field does not prove absence of such changes, only that documentation is missing."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1st54eg",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "An external factor (third-party work, utility outage) affecting the supply could have caused localized pressure loss at P-R while upstream remained stable if that factor impacted only a specific branch.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no external factors affected the supply, this causal path would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure loss could have been caused by internal equipment failure (e.g., valve malfunction) rather than an external factor.","evidenceGap": "No evidence identifies whether third-party work or utility outages occurred in proximity to the affected branch during the incident window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1sd8vsk",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The pressure extract provides only sampled values and excludes data from all locations or valve states, which limits the ability to determine whether a localized issue (e.g., open field valves) caused the pressure loss at P-R.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If continuous data and valve-state records were available, the causal link between field conditions and pressure loss could be established.",
      "competingExplanation": "The sampled values might still capture a transient event if sampling frequency was sufficient; however, evidence does not confirm this.","evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether the sampling interval captured the exact moment of valve opening or other condition change that caused the pressure drop."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify the point of interruption or valve states, which prevents linking specific field conditions to the pressure loss.",

      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],

      "counterfactual": "If the shift log had identified valve states or interruption points, this enabling condition would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure loss could have occurred due to a system-wide event unrelated to boundary preparation activities.","evidenceGap": "No record provides details on what specific actions were taken during 'boundary preparation' that might relate to the incident."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1w3niil",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, which limits the ability to determine whether field valves were open contrary to procedure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory had established valve positions, this enabling condition would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure loss could have been caused by a malfunctioning instrument rather than an open field valve.","evidenceGap": "No record provides actual valve position data for the time of the incident."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lde5sa",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented confirmation between Utilities and RHOB that air-low alarm was understood may have contributed to delayed response or misinterpretation of the event.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "q-8irrr9"

      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If confirmation had been documented, this enabling condition would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The alarm may have been understood but misinterpreted due to other factors (e.g., noise, distance).","evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether communication occurred or was effective between Utilities and RHOB regarding the air-low indication."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-jg4jvc",
      "toKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented breakdown in communication between Utilities and RHOB regarding air-low indication may have contributed to delayed response or misinterpretation of the event.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "q-isvv2m"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If communication had been effective, this enabling condition would not exist.",
      "competingExplanation": "The alarm may have been understood but misinterpreted due to other factors (e.g., noise, distance).","evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether communication occurred or was effective between Utilities and RHOB regarding the air-low indication."
    }

  "decision": {
    "summary": "The causal analysis identifies multiple unknown conditions that could have contributed to the instrument-air interruption. Key gaps include lack of evidence on field valve positions, unrecorded service-routing changes, external factors affecting supply, and communication effectiveness between Utilities and RHOB. The pressure extract's limited sampling further complicates determining whether a localized issue caused the event.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1",
      "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1",
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1",
      "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Field valve positions at time of incident.",
      "Whether unrecorded service-routing changes occurred.",
      "External factors affecting supply (third-party work, utility outage).",
      "Effectiveness of communication between Utilities and RHOB regarding air-low indication."
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Pressure loss caused by upstream event rather than downstream condition.",
      "System-wide failure unrelated to boundary preparation activities."
    ],"confidence": 0.65 },"evidenceRequests": []}
